WPMS No. 2430 of 2018 
With 
CLMA No. 12292/2018 (Stay Application) 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
Issue notices to the respondents, who may file 
their counter affidavit(s) by the next date of listing. 
The effect and operation of the impugned 
order shall remain stayed and the parties to the Writ 
Petition are restrained from alienating the property. 
Stay Application stands disposed of. 
 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 14.08.2018 
Pooja

Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for the

Mr. M.S. Tyagi, Advocate for the

The Stay Vacation Application (CLMA No. 
11131/2020) is taken on record. The counter 
affidavit also filed by respondent nos. 1 and 2 
would constitute to be the records of the writ 
petition.
The petitioners’ counsel prays for and is 
granted two weeks’ time to file the rejoinder 
affidavit.
List thereafter.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)

Pooja
